chapter.verse: Kote tungah hi loin, Topa aw, kote tungah hi loin, na itna kip leh na thumanna hangin nangma tungah minthan’na om ta hen!
Bang hangin minamte in, “Amaute’ Pasian koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci laizang ding ahi uh hiam?
Vantungah eite’ Pasian om a, ama ut peuhpeuh a hih hi.
Amaute’ milimte pen ngun leh kham hi a, mihingte’ khut tawh kibawl ahi hi.
Amaute in kam nei napi-in pau thei lo uh a, mit nei napi-in khua mu thei lo uh hi.
Amaute in bil nei napi-in khua za lo uh a, nak nei napi-in nam thei lo uh hi.
Amaute in khut nei napi-in lawng thei lo uh a, khe nei napi-in lam pai thei lo uh hi; amaute in aw gingsak thei lo uh hi.
Amaute a bawlte leh amaute a muangte khempeuh pen amaute mah tawh kibang uh hi.
Israelte aw, Topa muang un! Amah in note hong huhpa leh hong hupa ahi hi.
Aaron innkuante aw, Topa muang un! amah in note hong huhpa leh hong hupa ahi hi.
Topa a zahtakte aw, Topa muang un! Amah in note hong huhpa leh hong hupa ahi hi.
Topa in eite hong phawk a, amah in thupha hong pia ding hi; amah in Israel mite, thupha hong pia ding a, amah in Aaron’ innkuante thupha hong pia ding hi;
amah in Topa a zahtakte alian aneu-in thupha hong pia ding hi.
Topa in note leh na tate uh hong pung sak ta hen!
Van leh lei a bawl Topa in note thupha hong pia ta hen!
Vantung pen Topa ’ aa hi a, ahih hangin leitung pen mihingte’ tungah amah in hong pia khin hi.
Misite ahi a, gamdaihna sunga a pai peuhpeuhte in ahi zongin Topa phat lo uh hi.
Ahih hangin eite in tu-a kipanin a tawntungin Topa i phat ngitnget ding hi. Topa phat un!
